jobs.title: Clean Energy Intern - Data Cyber Security and Privacy at New York State Department of Public Service
jobs.description: Employer: New York State Department of Public Service Expires: 09/16/2026 The Clean Energy Intern will contribute to the development and implementation of New York’s Climate Leadership & Community Protection Act (CLCPA) which adopts the most ambitious climate and clean energy agenda in the country. The CLCPA establishes aggressive targets to fully transition New York State to a green energy economy and provides a framework to ensure that the transition is equitable and just across all sectors. Interns will interact with senior staff at the Department of Public Service through briefings on project development and implementation. Applicants should be enrolled in a graduate program and possess the following:Desire to work in the clean energy sector, supporting renewable energy, energy efficiency, building electrification, electric vehicle charging and distributed energy resource technologiesExcellent written and verbal communication skillsStrong attention to detail and organization skillsStrong skills in generating actionable insights from data through a combination of quantitative analysis and qualitative interpretationDuties Description:The clean energy transition envisioned by the CLCPA will require significant changes in how buildings use energy and, in turn, how the State’s energy systems supply this energy. Data related to energy consumption patterns is critical to understand to develop viable solutions. While this data is critical, the provision of such data must include appropriate data cyber security and data privacy protections. The Clean Energy Intern will develop an in-depth knowledge of existing energy data access mechanisms and the New York Public Service Commission’s Data Access Framework. The Public Service Commission (Commission) instituted a Strategic Use of Energy Data proceeding in 2020, followed by the ordering of the design, development, and implementation of a statewide Integrated Energy Data Resource (IEDR) and the adoption of the Data Access Framework. The Clean Energy Intern should comprehend risk mitigation and compliance and have an interest in the intersection between technology and the law as they apply to energy related data. Ideal candidates should have a desire to develop solutions that disrupt the status quo by way of innovative information technology (IT) solutions including the incorporation of innovation technologies into existing infrastructure / technology solutions in landscapes with constraints of various types. Responsibilities & Deliverables:Evaluating the plans and IT investments of utilities related to gathering and the utilization of energy related data using various analytic lenses: proposal feasibility, complexity of solution, cost-effectiveness, accuracy of estimates, degree of fit compared to alternatives, timelines required to produce benefits, strategic value, etc. Maintaining knowledge of existing energy data access mechanisms and the Commission’s Data Access Framework.Constructively engaging with the project team on the design, development, and operation of the IEDR.Drafting recommendations to the Commission that balance the numerous and complex issues related to the intersection of access to energy related data, privacy, and cyber security. Determining whether utility data related efforts and IT investments are planned and progressing at reasonable and appropriate levels to effectively meet the needs of the State policies, especially regarding time, budget, project requirements, benefit delivery, risk mitigation, and the use of industry best practices.Identifying and characterizing the types of data-related IT project implementation information required from utilities.Making recommendations regarding the requirement of communications protocols and other technical standards.Analyzing data issues to solve problems impacting data users’ respective functions.Additional Information:Salary: Graduate Interns earn $21.22/hour.Hours: Up to 37.5 hours per week. Office Location: 3 Empire State Plaza, Albany, New York.Remote Work: A hybrid work schedule may be possible. How to apply: Please send your resume and cover letter to recruiting@dps.ny.gov and reference “Clean Energy Internship: Data Cybersecurity – Fall 2026”

Required Skills & QualificationsStrong Foundation in C++: Solid grasp of C++ fundamentals (STL, memory management, move semantics, templates). Production experience not required; demonstrated projects or coursework show readiness.Core CS Fundamentals: Comfortable with data structures, algorithms, and basic systems concepts (threading, process synchronization).Quick Learner: Able to rapidly pick up new tools, libraries, and frameworks with minimal guidance.Linux Familiarity: Comfortable working in Linux environments; shell scripting and command-line tools are a plus.Collaborative Mindset: Excellent communication skills; eager to learn from mentors and ask clarifying questions. Preferred Skills Multi-threading Experience: Practical familiarity with concurrent programming, thread safety, and synchronization primitives.Network Programming: Exposure to socket programming, TCP/IP, or distributed system basics.Additional Languages: Proficiency in Python, C#, or other systems languages broadens your perspective.Financial Markets Interest: Curiosity about trading, equities, options, or how financial markets work—we teach the rest.Database Exposure: Familiarity with SQL or understanding of how databases store and retrieve data at scale.Version Control & Tooling: Experience with Git, debugging tools (gdb, valgrind), or profilers (perf, flamegraph). Personal Attributes Intellectual Curiosity: Genuine interest in understanding how systems work, from code to infrastructure to business outcomes.Growth Mindset: Embrace challenges and feedback as opportunities to learn. We expect you to grow significantly over the internship.Ownership & Initiative: Proactive in seeking learning opportunities and taking on well-scoped responsibilities with minimal oversight.Adaptability: Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid changes; thriving in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.Collaborative Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with a preference for brainstorming and learning from teammates.Passion for Technology: Excitement about staying current with modern C++ and high-performance systems. What You'll GainHands-On Production Experience: Work in a real, production trading environment—not a sandbox. Your code runs strategies that generate revenue.Mentorship from Experts: Learn directly from senior engineers with deep expertise in low-latency systems, C++, and financial technology.Comprehensive Technical Knowledge: Understand high-performance systems design, from kernel tuning to network stack optimization.Career Acceleration: Build a portfolio of impactful projects and establish relationships with leaders in fintech.Potential for Conversion: Strong performers are considered for full-time roles upon graduation or at the conclusion of the internship. jobs.description: Employer: City of San Jose Expires: 09/17/2026 Our diverse and inclusive workforce of more than 7,000 employees play a key role in the success of San José, the heart of the Silicon Valley. All City of San José employees work together as one team to make San José a vibrant, innovative, and desirable place to live and work. Visit here to learn more about our One Team Leadership Values and Expectations, including quality and excellent customer service and here to learn more about San José.The City of San José is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants for all job openings will be considered without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status or any other consideration made unlawful under any federal, state or local laws. The City of San José is committed to offering reasonable accommodations to job applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at 408-535-1285, 711 (TTY), or via email at CityCareers@sanjoseca.gov.About the Department San José Clean Energy, or SJCE, is San José’s local, not-for-profit electricity supplier operated by the City of San José’s Energy Department. Since 2019, our dedicated and motivated team has provided clean energy for residents and businesses at competitive rates, while also offering community programs, local benefits, and increased transparency and accessibility. SJCE serves more than 350,000 customer accounts, and has contracted for more than 1 GW of power. Joining our team means that you will be making a big impact on the fight against climate change. SJCE plays an important role in meeting San José’s ambitious goal to be carbon neutral by 2030 and in implementing the City’s climate action plan, Climate Smart San José. Thanks to SJCE, San Jose has one of the cleanest energy mixes of any large city and offers a 60% renewable product and a 100% renewable product.Serving our community with respect and integrity is at the core of what we do. We center equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging in our work. The department also hosts active staff-led Culture and Racial Equity committees, and has won awards for its education and outreach work with Spanish and Vietnamese-speaking communities. For more information about San José Clean Energy, please visit:www.sanjosecleanenergy.org.**Please note, in order to be considered for this recruitment, candidates are required to upload a copy of their current school schedule with the accredited college or university's name** Position Duties The Energy Department is looking to fill one (1) Power Resources Specialist Graduate Student Intern (Unclassified) (Part-time) position.The Power Resources Specialist Intern’s primary responsibility will be to assist SJCE with the analysis of energy markets and renewable energy technologies. Projects could include:Evaluating California’s wholesale energy markets.Evaluating renewable energy technologies, market performance, availability and commercial viability.Assisting with the development of internal tools to process and evaluate large amounts of market data, such as CAISO system demand, market clearing prices, and grid outages.Assisting with the development of internal dashboards and reports to present data, research findings, and market insights.Researching and attending market events to increase awareness of market trends, technology innovations, and product availability. Preparing summary materials and presenting findings to internal teams.Researching analytical tools, software, and other market data resources to inform internal system or process enhancements. These tools may include open-source resources.Assisting with scenario analysis and back-testing.Assisting with primary research related to Power Purchase Agreements, resource performance and industry standard provisions. Additionally, this intern will support SJCE’s ongoing business operations and general office processes. Responsibilities may include attending internal and external meetings, preparing and organizing materials, drafting and editing correspondence, proofreading documents, maintaining records, and providing other general administrative and business support as needed.Pay: Graduate Student Intern: $21.14 - $31.22 per hour (unclassified, unbenefited) This salary range includes an approximate five percent (5%) ongoing non-pensionable compensation. The actual salary will be determined based on the final candidate’s qualifications and experience.Work Schedule: During the academic year, interns are recommended to work 24-40 hours per week, with schedules determined collaboratively between the hiring manager and the intern based on student availability and project needs. During summer and winter breaks, interns may work up to 40 hours per week. Minimum QualificationsTraining and Experience:Any combination of training and experience equivalent to completion of a Bachelor's Degree and current enrollment in a Masters degree program from an accredited college or university in business or public administration or closely related field.Licenses and CertificatesPossession of a valid driver's license authorizing operation of a motor vehicle in the state of California may be required in performing job duties.Desired skills: Experience conducting primary and secondary research from credible sourcesExperience attaining, processing, and cleaning data (preferably energy data)Experience/knowledge of programming languages such as Python or RExperience with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)(Bonus) Knowledge or familiarity with: CAISO or any other ISO/RTO, wholesale energy market mechanics, resource technologies, resource scheduling, and or Power Purchase Agreements. Desired Education: Data Science / Data AnalyticsComputer ScienceStatistics / Applied MathematicsSustainable Energy Systems Other QualificationsSelection ProcessThe selection process will consist of an evaluation of the applicant's training and experience based on the application and responses to all the job specific questions. Only those candidates whose backgrounds best match the position will be invited to proceed in the selection process. Additional phases of the selection process will consist of one or more interviews.If you have questions about the duties of these positions, the selection or hiring processes, please contact Adrienne Barreto at Adrienne.Barreto@sanjoseca.gov Additional Information:Employment Eligibility: Federal law requires all employees to provide verification of their eligibility to work in this country. Please be informed that the City of San Jose will NOT sponsor, represent or sign any documents related to visa applications/transfers for H1-B or any other type of visa which requires an employer application. You must answer all job-specific questions to be considered for this vacancy or your application will be deemed incomplete and withheld from further consideration. Applicants are expected to write their own essays/responses. Please note that applications are currently not accepted through CalOpps or any other third party job board application system.This recruitment may be used to fill multiple positions in this, or other divisions or departments. If you are interested in employment in this classification, you should apply to ensure you are considered for additional opportunities that may utilize the applicants from this recruitment.Please allow adequate time to complete the application and submit before the deadline or the system may not save your application. If your online application was successfully submitted, you will receive an automatic confirmation email to the email address you provided. IF YOU DO NOT RECEIVE THE CONFIRMATION, please email CityCareers@sanjoseca.gov and we will research the status of your application. AI and the Hiring ProcessWe recognize that Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming part of daily life and can be a valuable tool for learning, research, and professional growth. We encourage candidates to use AI responsibly as a support in preparing application materials, live assessments, and interviews. However, we value authenticity, accuracy and truthfulness. Application responses and interview answers must reflect your own knowledge, skills, and experiences. While AI can supplement preparation, it cannot replace the originality and judgment we look for in our employees. This ensures fairness, transparency, and equity for all applicants in the hiring process.

jobs.title: Environmental Engineering Intern at Rich Earth Institute
jobs.description: Employer: Rich Earth Institute Expires: 09/19/2026 Rich Earth Institute Internship: Environmental Engineering & Sustainable Fertilizer ResearchEligibility: Must be a Vermont resident to qualify for this position.Compensation: $15-18/hour Depending on ExperienceDuration: This is a part-time position with a flexible work schedule; approximately 40 weeks (at 8 hours/week); open until filled About the Rich Earth InstituteNutrient pollution from wastewater is one of the leading causes of harmful algal blooms, which impair water quality in nearly 70% of U.S. waterways. At the same time, manufacturing synthetic fertilizers is energy-intensive, relies on finite resources, and contributes significantly to greenhouse gas emissions.The Rich Earth Institute is developing solutions to both challenges by recovering nutrients from human urine and returning them to agriculture as fertilizer. Urine contains all the nutrients plants need to grow, and although it represents only about 1% of household wastewater by volume, urine is the source of most of the nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium found in wastewater.Founded in 2012 and based in Brattleboro, Vermont, the Rich Earth Institute operates the first community-scale Urine Nutrient Reclamation Program in the United States. The Institute collects and recycles approximately 13,000 gallons of source-separated human urine each year, transforming it into fertilizer for farms in southern Vermont. Through research, education, and technological innovation, Rich Earth is advancing the safe and sustainable recovery of nutrients from human waste. Internship Overview:The Rich Earth Institute is seeking a motivated intern interested in environmental engineering, biological systems, or sustainable agriculture to support applied research on an innovative nutrient recovery technology.The intern will contribute to the development of a biological nitrification reactor (inspired by the low-tech "pitribon" reactor) for converting nitrogen-rich waste streams (including source-separated human urine and liquid dairy manure digestate) into a stable, odorless, high-quality liquid fertilizer. jobs.title: Hardware & Automation Test Intern / Junior Engineer at Global ETS
jobs.description: Employer: Global ETS Expires: 09/23/2026 About the RoleWe're an innovative semiconductor testing company looking for a motivated student or junior engineer to help us bridge the gap between hardware reality and modern AI-driven automation. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with our senior engineers, get hands-on exposure to real test-floor operations in an advanced electronics environment, and contribute to the tools and test flows we rely on every single day.This is a learning-first position. More than a perfect resume, we value your curiosity, your attention to detail, and your willingness to get hands-on with both code and hardware.What You'll Work On1. Circuit Theory & Hardware AnalysisThis is the foundation for everything else. You'll use oscilloscopes and multimeters to trace signal integrity issues and perform power analysis, and you'll carry out basic PCB modifications and SMD soldering under the guidance of senior engineers. Our belief: only when you truly understand what the hardware is doing can AI actually help.2. Process Automation via Vibe CodingYou'll use Python to automate parsing test data, cleaning logs, and generating yield reports—but the point isn't hand-crafting every line. It's about driving development through intent, iterating quickly alongside AI, and being able to read, modify, and verify the code the AI produces. The core of coding is shifting from "can you write it" to "can you steer the AI to write it correctly."3. AI Agentic Test FlowsYou'll help the team evaluate and integrate AI development tools so machine learning can accelerate our debugging and test processes, and you'll assist in developing and maintaining ATE (automated test equipment) test programs. Our goal isn't just to have AI answer questions—it's to design agentic pipelines that can autonomously connect to the bench, run tests, and produce reports.What We're Looking ForEnrolled in (or recently graduated from) an Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related program; a solid foundation in Circuit Theory—you should be able to read basic schematics and understand logic gates; comfortable with at least one programming language (Python or C/C++ preferred) as a basis for collaborating with AI; detail-oriented and willing to dig into unfamiliar hardware systems or massive data logs; and genuinely curious about how software directly controls and tests physical hardware in the real world.Nice to HaveHands-on experience with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters) or basic soldering skills; coursework or project experience with FPGA development (Verilog/VHDL) or digital logic; familiarity with—or strong interest in—integrating AI/ML APIs for data or coding automation.

jobs.description: Employer: Skyworks Solutions, Inc. Expires: 09/25/2026 Job Title: RFIC Design Summer InternIf you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. Through our broad technology expertise and one of the most extensive product portfolios in the industry, we are Connecting Everyone and Everything, All the Time. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management, and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creative thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together are changing the way the world communicates.Requisition ID: 78242 DescriptionJoin the Skyworks San Jose Design Center in developing high-performance silicon RFIC solutions for next-generation mobile applications. This internship offers hands-on experience in silicon RFIC design while working closely with experienced engineers in a collaborative team environment.The intern will contribute to the development of RF front-end integrated circuits from initial concept through production. The work will focus on transistor-level circuit design, simulation, layout, and laboratory evaluation of high-performance RF front-end circuits. The intern will also document results and present technical work to colleagues and stakeholders.Located in Silicon Valley near major customers, the San Jose Design Center provides access to highly integrated semiconductor, module, and embedded RF circuit design, an in-house prototype assembly laboratory, and a world-class RF characterization laboratory. This is an excellent opportunity to strengthen technical skills, expand a professional network, and prepare for a career in RFIC design.Responsibilities• Work with a mentor and design team to combine silicon RFIC design with RF and microwave electromagnetic simulation for high-performance RF switches, low-noise amplifiers, and other RF front-end components.• Participate in product development activities, including product definition, architecture, system analysis, transistor-level circuit design, layout or layout supervision, top-level simulation, laboratory debugging, and production test support.Required Experience and Skills• Currently enrolled in an Electrical Engineering (or related) BS or MS programs• In-person Summer internship beginning May/June 2027 (3 months) at the San Jose site• Familiarity with transistor-level design concepts for silicon RFIC and analog circuits.• Understanding of RF active-circuit requirements and design concepts, including noise, linearity, bandwidth, and small-signal and large-signal behavior.• Understanding of microwave and RF fundamentals, including S-parameters, Smith charts, matching networks, noise figure, and transmission lines.• Experience using time-domain and frequency-domain circuit and electromagnetic simulation tools, such as Cadence Spectre and EMX, Keysight ADS and Momentum, or Ansys HFSS.Desired Experience and Skills• Experience with on-chip passive circuit design; chip tapeout experience is a strong plus.• Experience with RF test equipment, including network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, DC power supplies, and RF probes. Our employees work on the world’s most advanced electronics – from saving emissions in the City of Lights to powering the Mars Rover to protecting the F-35 fighter jet. At BAE Systems you’ll be among the brightest minds, working on the aerospace and defense industry’s most difficult problems. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. And you can, too.How does it feel to work on a team driven to make a big impact? Empowering. We believe your career should always be growing. And that's exactly what it will do at BAE Systems. You’ll hit the ground running with a company truly committed to your growth as you enjoy a special camaraderie on a team dedicated to protecting what really matters.We are seeking high school graduates for full-time internships starting in Summer 2027. As a Software intern, you will join a team of engineers supporting software development opportunities that solve real world problems.Typical tasking includes:Designing, developing, and testing software solutions utilizing Agile methodologies and sound software engineering principles while conforming to existing code development strategies and processes.Assisting in other software engineering activities such as integration testing, algorithm & data analysis, software troubleshooting, and preparing documentation in accordance with established procedures.Utilizing a Windows PC or Linux based software development environment and either x86 or PowerPC target and test environment.In addition to your technical assignment, you will participate in BAE Systems' nationwide LEAP Internship & Co-op Program, where you will Learn, Engage, Apply, and Progress within the company. The LEAP Program will provide you with additional opportunities to engage in career development opportunities, and network with our business leaders and the other students in the program.This internship will be located onsite at one of our facilities in southern New Hampshire including Nashua, Hudson, Manchester, and Merrimack.Please note that pursuant to a government contract, this specific position requires US citizenship status.Required Education, Experience, & Skills Must be a high school graduate prior to summer 2027 and be enrolled in an undergraduate program for CS (Computer Science), CE (Computer Engineering), or a related field.Programming experience in at least one or more of the following languages: C, C++, Java, Python.Strong interpersonal and written and verbal communication skillsExperience with Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc.)Demonstrated self-motivation and ability to work independentlyMust be eligible for a US DoD security clearancePreferred Education, Experience, & Skills Past/current participant in one of BAE Systems Outreach programs including FOCUS, FIRST Robotics, WIT, and/or Early Career Day (ECD).Knowledge of Data Structures and Object-Oriented Design/DevelopmentKnowledge of AGILE based developmentExperience with Windows and/or Linux Operating SystemsExperience using common software version control tools such as GitSecurity clearance (secret or higher)Pay InformationFull-Time Salary Range: $35792 - $49809Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.Temporary employees generally are not eligible for BAE Systems benefits, but can elect to participate in the 401(k) savings plan. Temporary employees working 20+ hours per week are eligible for medical benefits, the employee assistance program, and business travel accident insurance.About BAE Systems Electronic SystemsBAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Electronic Systems (ES) is the global innovator behind BAE Systems’ game-changing defense and commercial electronics. Exploiting every electron, we push the limits of what is possible, giving our customers the edge and our employees opportunities to change the world. Our products and capabilities can be found everywhere – from the depths of the ocean to the far reaches of space. At our core are more than 14,000 highly talented Electronic Systems employees with the brightest minds in the industry, we make an impact – for our customers and the communities we serve.This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.description: Employer: VGI Technology, Inc Expires: 09/26/2026 Digital Operations Support and Development SpecialistInternship PositionDepartment: Digital Operations and MarketingLocation: San Angelo, TexasEmployment Type: InternshipReports To: Chief Digital Officer and Director of MarketingPosition SummaryThe Digital Operations Support and Development Specialist Intern works with VGI Technology's Digital Operations and Marketing teams to develop, improve, test, and support software applications, digital tools, business automations, system integrations, dashboards, and reporting solutions.This is a hands-on technology internship. Interns will work on practical business projects rather than observation-only assignments. Projects may involve internal business applications, customer-facing software, artificial intelligence, APIs, databases, reporting, workflow automation, websites, and integration between business systems.The internship is designed to give students experience taking a business requirement from initial discussion through research, prototyping, development, testing, documentation, and implementation.What the Intern Will DoInterns may participate in assignments such as:Application Development: Help design, build, test, and improve internal business applications and customer-facing software.AI-Assisted Development: Use approved artificial intelligence tools and development resources to assist with research, prototyping, coding, troubleshooting, analysis, and application functionality.Business Process Automation: Identify repetitive or manual processes and help develop workflows and automations that make those processes faster and more reliable.Systems Integration: Work with APIs, databases, and other integration technologies to exchange information between business applications.Data Analysis and Reporting: Use tools such as Microsoft Excel, Power BI, SQL, and Python to organize business data, analyze results, identify trends, and create reports and dashboards.Business and Financial Analysis: Assist with projects that use operational and financial data to evaluate costs, revenue, efficiency, resource utilization, performance, and other business metrics.Dashboard Development: Build or enhance management dashboards that convert operational and business data into useful information for decision-making.Website and Marketing Technology: Support website applications, digital marketing tools, campaign reporting, customer communications, and related technology initiatives.Requirements Analysis: Meet with business users to understand a problem or opportunity and translate those requirements into a technical solution, prototype, or development plan.Application Testing: Test new and existing applications, reproduce reported problems, document defects, validate corrections, and help ensure software performs as expected.Troubleshooting and Support: Investigate software, data, integration, and workflow problems and help develop practical solutions.Technical Documentation: Create documentation for applications, workflows, integrations, testing procedures, configuration, and user instructions.Project Support: Participate in active technology projects and help coordinate assigned work from initial requirements through completion.Examples of Internship ProjectsDepending on current company priorities and the student's skills, an intern could be asked to:Build a dashboard that combines operational and financial information for management.Automate a manual Excel or reporting process.Develop or enhance an internal web application used by VGI employees.Create an API integration between two business systems.Analyze business data using SQL, Excel, Power BI, or Python and present the findings.Help develop an AI-enabled feature for an existing VGI application.Test a new customer-facing application and document defects and recommended improvements.Create a workflow that eliminates repetitive data entry.Assist with reporting from CRM, ERP, marketing, project-management, or other business systems.Develop technical and user documentation for a newly implemented application or process.Learning ObjectivesThrough the internship, the student should gain practical experience in:Translating real business problems into technology solutions.Understanding how technology affects cost, revenue, productivity, efficiency, and business decision-making.Developing and testing software in a professional business environment.Working with structured business data and databases.Using APIs to connect different technology platforms.Applying data analytics and visualization to business questions.Using artificial intelligence responsibly as a professional productivity and development tool.Understanding cybersecurity, privacy, identity, access control, and data-governance considerations.Communicating technical information to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.Managing assignments, priorities, deadlines, documentation, and deliverables.Presenting completed work and explaining its business value.Financial Literacy and Business RelevanceAlthough this is primarily a technology and digital-operations internship, students will gain exposure to the financial implications of technology decisions.Projects may require interns to work with financial and operational data, analyze costs, evaluate process efficiency, measure the impact of automation, develop management reports, and understand how technology investments contribute to organizational performance.This provides an opportunity for students to connect technical skills with fundamental business concepts such as revenue, expense, profitability, productivity, return on investment, resource allocation, budgeting, and data-driven decision-making.Desired Academic BackgroundThe internship is appropriate for students pursuing a bachelor's degree in areas such as:Computer ScienceComputer Information SystemsManagement Information SystemsData AnalyticsCybersecurityBusiness AnalyticsFinance or Accounting with strong technology/data skillsOther related technology or business disciplinesA completed degree is not required for internship candidates.Desired Technical SkillsCandidates should have coursework, experience, or a strong interest in several of the following:PythonSQLJavaScript or comparable programming languagesMicrosoft ExcelPower BI or other business-intelligence toolsDatabasesREST APIs and system integrationsWeb application developmentArtificial intelligence and generative AISource controlApplication testingTechnical documentationExperience with technologies such as React, Node.js, .NET, cloud platforms, Docker, GitHub, and CI/CD is beneficial but not required for every internship assignment.Professional SkillsSuccessful interns should demonstrate:Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies.Good written and verbal communication.Organization and attention to detail.Ability to manage assigned priorities and follow through on commitments.Ability to work independently when appropriate while seeking guidance when needed.Ability to collaborate with technical and nontechnical employees.Professional handling of company and customer information.Supervision and Responsible Technology UseInterns will work under the direction of VGI Technology leadership and designated project stakeholders.Interns may participate in the development and testing of real business solutions; however, material production changes, external product releases, access to sensitive information, and other significant system changes require appropriate review and authorization.Students will also be expected to follow VGI Technology standards for security, privacy, access control, data quality, software quality, and responsible use of artificial intelligence.How Success Will Be MeasuredIntern performance will be evaluated based on:Product Delivery — Produces functional and maintainable work that addresses assigned requirements.Operational Impact — Contributes to improved workflows, reduced manual effort, stronger integrations, or better access to information.Quality and Security — Tests and documents work appropriately while protecting company and customer information.Communication and Professionalism — Communicates progress, questions, findings, and technical information clearly and professionally.Problem Solving — Demonstrates the ability to investigate problems, evaluate alternatives, and develop practical solutions.Adaptability — Learns and effectively applies new technologies, development tools, and business concepts as project needs evolve.Internship ExperienceVGI Technology intends this internship to provide students with meaningful, portfolio-worthy professional experience. Interns will have the opportunity to see how software development, artificial intelligence, data analytics, financial information, marketing technology, and business operations work together inside an operating technology company.The objective is for students to leave the internship with more than exposure to technology—they should be able to demonstrate projects they contributed to, explain the business problems those projects addressed, describe the technologies and methods they used, and articulate the measurable or practical value their work created.VGI Technology, Inc.San Angelo, TexasConnecting and protecting our communities using innovative technologies while providing an exceptional customer experience.

jobs.description: Employer: Allianz Life Expires: 09/26/2026 At Allianz Life, we are driven by our mission – we secure your future – and by our common goal of caring for tomorrow. During the program, Hedging Intern Analysts will work alongside our team of quants, portfolio managers, software developers, researchers, and traders to assess and mitigate the market risks for Allianz Life and other clients across the globe. This includes holders of H-1B, H4, L-1, L-2, TN, OPT, CPT, and other nonimmigrant visas. Base Salary Range $31/hr – $35/hrNote the job posting range is exclusive of company benefits or other compensation. If you are hired, your final base salary will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, experience, skills, competencies, and/or education. In addition to those factors, we will also consider internal equity of our current employees. Please keep in mind that the range provided is the full base salary range for the role. Hiring at or near the maximum of the range would not be typical to allow for future and continued salary growth. What we offer:At Allianz Life, we’re proud to provide a benefits package that supports the True Balance of our employees and their families. We offer: a choice of comprehensive medical, dental and vision plan options, flexible spending and health savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, student loan retirement program, generous annual paid leave, an outstanding 401(k) company match, and life insurance. Plus, our employees enjoy an award-winning campus with an array of discounted amenities, including an onsite health center, child development center, fitness facility, convenience store and two cafeterias. Our employees and leaders take an active role in shaping our culture through our Employee Resource Groups, whose activities and advocacy contribute to an environment that is fair, caring, and inclusive. Our generous benefits, campus amenities and inclusive, engaged culture are among the many reasons we’re routinely recognized as a top workplace employer. For additional information regarding What It’s Like To Work Here | Allianz Life. Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative at Inner Peak
jobs.description: Employer: Inner Peak Expires: 09/27/2026 This position is ideal for a recent college graduate looking for their first sales role or a college student looking to earn a little extra money and gain valuable experience. We are a lean team trying to keep costs low. This role is compensated solely based on results - you will be paid per meeting you book for our CEO, as well as a percentage of any deal that closes. There is no base salary, and we have no flexibility on this. If you are not comfortable working on commission only, please do not apply. Summary: Inner Peak AI (www.innerpeak.ai) is blending new AI technology with human therapist expertise to deliver truly personalized, affordable mental wellness support 24/7. We are starting by serving high school and college students but eventually intend to be everyone’s mental wellness safety net, triaging users and delivering them to video content, human therapists, or crisis resources. We are a mission-driven company created out of our founders; own lived experience and struggles with mental health, and are still a small (but motivated) team. Peak’s founders met in undergrad at Harvard a decade ago before reconnecting recently over their shared interest in technology and mental health. We have built and launched a mobile application that has two thousand users and is live at several high schools. Initial student usage data is strong, giving us powerful case studies. To raise our next round of fundraising, we must scale this to more schools. We are looking for hungry interns who care about making a difference in peer mental health and who want high-upside potential through our performance-based compensation. This role is great training for anyone interested in going into sales, as you will report to a sales manager with 10+ years of sales experience. If you are successful at this role, over time it could turn into a full account executive role with a base salary.
